text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: costs 150 B as a compact packet, 74% less wire. The two are different example tracks:

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the Profile L example omits per-event timing quality and relies on periodic TIME_STATUS packets
